faq.question: How much does it cost to publish a listing?
faq.reponse: Publishing a listing is entirely free. No fee applies until your project is sold.

faq.question: What is the commission amount?
faq.reponse: La Citadelle's commission is 5% of the final sale price, with a minimum of €49. It is only charged when a sale succeeds.

faq.question: Can I sell by auction?
faq.reponse: Yes. When creating your listing, enable Auction mode, set a reserve price and a duration. Buyers bid until the closing.

faq.question: Can I have my project valued?
faq.reponse: Absolutely. Our valuation services (Standard and Certified Expert) are accessible from the Services page. A professional valuation reassures buyers and enhances your project.

faq.question: Who carries out the redesigns?
faq.reponse: Redesigns are carried out by the certified partners of the Syndicat du Code, under the supervision of La Garde. Each intervention is subject to a quote and personalized follow-up.

faq.question: How does the secure transaction work?
faq.reponse: When an offer is accepted, the buyer's funds are held in our escrow system. The seller hands over the access, La Garde verifies, and the funds are released after validation. No transfer without confirmation.

faq.question: What happens in case of a dispute?
faq.reponse: La Garde has a built-in dispute management system. The buyer or seller can open a dispute. Our experts analyze the situation and propose a fair resolution as quickly as possible.

hp.seo_h2: Buy or sell a website in complete safety
hp.seo_intro: La Citadelle Numérique is the French marketplace specialized in website sales. Whether you want to sell a profitable website, buy an already-positioned website, or transfer a SaaS, an e-commerce store or an application, we secure every transaction through escrow and the support of La Garde.
hp.seo_p1: The online business sales market has never been so active. Every day, entrepreneurs look for a website to buy to accelerate their growth, while others want to monetize years of work by selling their project. Finding the right buyer or the right asset remains difficult though: opaque prices, lack of guarantees, risky access handover. La Citadelle Numérique was designed to remove these obstacles.
hp.seo_p2: On our website marketplace, you access websites, e-commerce stores, SaaS, applications and domain names carefully presented. Each listing can detail traffic, revenue and the technology used, so that the sale of a SaaS, an e-commerce store or an application happens on clear foundations. Our free estimator helps you gauge an asset's value before even making an offer.
hp.seo_why1_desc: The buyer's funds are held in escrow until full verification and access handover. Seller and buyer are protected at every step.
hp.seo_why2_desc: Our team checks listings and supports the transfer from A to Z, for reliable digital assets and a website sale in full confidence.
hp.seo_why3_desc: Estimate the value of your website, SaaS or e-commerce store for free, then refine it with an expert assessment by our analysts.
hp.seo_why4_desc: A website marketplace based in France, with compliant invoicing, French-language mediation and a dedicated contact: La Garde.
hp.seo_sell1: Estimate the value of your asset with our free tool, then publish your listing for free (website, e-commerce, SaaS, application or domain name).
hp.seo_sell2: Receive buyers' offers and chat securely via messaging; accept the offer that suits you or launch an auction.
hp.seo_sell3: The buyer pays via escrow, La Garde verifies the access handover, then the funds are paid to you. The transfer is protected from start to finish.
hp.seo_buy1: Browse websites for sale and filter by type, budget, traffic or revenue to find the online business that matches your project.
hp.seo_buy2: Contact the seller, request additional information and make an offer — or bid on assets offered at auction.
hp.seo_buy3: Pay via escrow: your funds are only released once the access has been received and verified. You buy a website with peace of mind.
hp.seo_guarantees: Every website sale is protected by escrow: the buyer's money is only released after verification and access handover by La Garde. In case of disagreement, our team provides mediation and issues a handover certificate that formalizes the transfer. Sellers and buyers thus benefit from a professional, transparent and fully secure framework to buy or sell an online business.

est_faq.q: How much is my website worth?
est_faq.a: Your site's value is calculated by multiplying your average monthly net profit by a market multiple (8x to 30x depending on type and age). A content site generating €1,000/month is generally worth between €12,000 and €18,000 on the French market.

est_faq.q: How to estimate the value of a website in France?
est_faq.a: The standard method in France is the SDE multiple: Value = Monthly net profit × Multiple. This multiple ranges from 8x (recent site) to 30x (mature SaaS). Our team performs free professional estimates based on your real data.

est_faq.q: What is the price of a profitable website to sell?
est_faq.a: A profitable site sells for between 12 and 22 times its monthly net profit in France. Well-established SaaS can reach 22 to 30 times. Age, revenue diversification and SEO quality strongly influence the multiple.

home_faq.q: How to sell a website on La Citadelle Numérique?
home_faq.a: Create a free account, publish your listing (activity, technologies, traffic, revenue, price) and validate it. Once a buyer is found, payment is held in escrow: you hand over the site, then the funds are paid to you after verification.

home_faq.q: How to buy a website or an online business?
home_faq.a: Browse verified listings, chat with the seller, then pay via the platform. Your funds remain in escrow with La Garde de La Citadelle until the complete and verified handover of the asset.

home_faq.q: What types of digital assets can I buy or sell?
home_faq.a: Websites, blogs, e-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop), SaaS and applications, domain names, YouTube channels, social media accounts and pages, Discord servers, newsletters, podcasts and other monetizable digital projects.

The buyer pays via the platform; funds are held by a trusted third party (La Garde de La Citadelle) and are only paid to the seller once the asset is handed over and verified. Escrow is technically provided via Stripe Connect.

home_faq.q: How much does it cost to publish a listing?
home_faq.a: Publishing a listing is free. A commission is only charged in case of a successful sale.

home_faq.q: How is the value of a site or SaaS estimated?
home_faq.a: La Citadelle offers a Standard Estimate (quick) and an Expert Estimate (detailed report). The estimate is based on a revenue multiple, adjusted for traffic, revenue diversity, technology and business stability.

estimation.faq_sub: Valuation · Methods · Professional estimate in France

faq.q: How do I estimate the value of my website in France?
faq.a: The value of a website in France is calculated using the SDE multiple method: Value = Monthly net profit × Multiple. This multiple (8x to 30x) is adjusted based on the quality of organic SEO traffic, monthly growth rate and revenue diversification. Our tool factors in these 5 parameters for a realistic range.

faq.q: How much does a professional website estimate cost?
faq.a: Requesting a professional estimate on La Citadelle Numérique is entirely free and with no commitment. Our team analyzes your real data (Analytics, Stripe, GSC) and delivers a valuation report within 48 business hours.

faq.q: What multiple is used to value a SaaS in France?
faq.a: A mature French SaaS (3 to 5 years) is valued between 18x and 26x its monthly net profit. With strong growth and low churn, the multiple can reach 22x to 30x. An early-stage SaaS (< 1 year) will be valued around 10x–15x.

faq.q: Why does SEO traffic affect the value of my site?
faq.a: Dominant organic traffic (> 60%) means revenue does not depend on paid advertising. It is a stable, predictable asset that reduces risk for the buyer and justifies a valuation premium of 7 to 15% compared to a site fully dependent on ads.

faq.q: What is the difference between the free estimator and the professional estimate?
faq.a: The free estimator gives a range based on declared parameters. The professional estimate includes verification of real revenue (Stripe/PayPal screenshots), analysis of Google Analytics and Search Console traffic, comparison with similar recent transactions, and a written report that holds up to a buyer's scrutiny.

legalDocs.cgu_md:
> These Terms of Use (ToU) govern access to and use of the **La Citadelle Numérique** platform, operated by **JOERKE.B SASU** (SIREN 892 906 728), whose registered office is located at 11 Rue Urbain IV, 10000 Troyes, France. By accessing the platform, the user unreservedly accepts these ToU.

**Update v2.0 (July 2026):** Addition of articles 5, 6 and 7 concerning the Secure Transaction, the escrow mechanism, the platform commission, the use of Stripe Connect and identity verification (KYC).

## 1. Definitions

- **Platform:** the La Citadelle Numérique website accessible at lacitadellenumerique.fr.
- **Publisher:** JOERKE.B SASU, the operator of the platform.
- **User:** any natural or legal person accessing the platform.
- **Member:** a user with a registered and active account.
- **Seller:** a member offering a digital asset for sale.
- **Buyer:** a member wishing to acquire a digital asset.
- **Listing:** the publication of a digital asset for sale on the platform.
- **La Garde:** the operational team of La Citadelle Numérique in charge of transaction monitoring and mediation.
- **Secure Transaction:** a financial intermediation mechanism whereby the buyer's funds are held in escrow on the platform's account until the transaction is validated.
- **Escrow:** the temporary retention of the buyer's funds on the platform's payment account (managed by Stripe), during the verification of access and confirmation of the sale.
- **Commission:** the fee charged by the platform on the total amount of each finalised sale, in accordance with article 6.
- **Stripe / Stripe Connect:** the licensed payment service provider (Stripe Payments Europe Ltd, 1 Grand Canal Street Lower, Dublin 2, Ireland) used by the platform to process payments and payouts to sellers.
- **Connect Account:** a Stripe Express account created in the seller's name to enable the automatic receipt of funds at the end of each sale.
- **KYC (Know Your Customer):** the identity verification procedure required by anti-money-laundering regulations (AML-CFT) for sellers receiving funds via the platform.

## 2. Access to the platform

Access to the platform is free and open for consulting the published listings.

Creating an account is required to publish a listing, contact a seller or carry out a transaction.

### Access conditions

To create an account, the user must:

- Be at least **18 years old** (legal age to contract in France)
- Have a valid email address
- Unreservedly accept these ToU and the Terms of Sale
- Not be subject to a prior suspension or exclusion from the platform

### Additional seller obligations

Any member wishing to sell a digital asset and receive funds via the platform must also:

- Provide their **date of birth** and **phone number** in their member area
- Complete the **identity verification (KYC)** process via Stripe Connect (article 7)
- Accept the Stripe Connect Terms of Service

## 3. Account creation and management

### Registration

The user undertakes to provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information when registering. Any account created with false information may be suspended without notice.

### Account security

The user is solely responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials. Any use of the account made with their credentials is presumed to have been made by the user themselves. In the event of a compromise, the user must immediately contact La Garde at lagarde@lacitadellenumerique.fr.

### Single account

Each user may hold only one active account. Creating multiple accounts is prohibited and may result in the deletion of all the accounts concerned.

## 4. User obligations

The user undertakes to:

- Use the platform in accordance with its purpose and with these ToU
- Not publish unlawful, misleading, defamatory content or content infringing third-party rights
- Not attempt to circumvent the platform's transaction mechanisms (e.g. sharing direct contact details in messages to finalise a sale off-platform)
- Not use automated devices (robots, scrapers) without the publisher's written authorisation
- Respect the intellectual property rights of the platform and of other users
- Report any suspicious behaviour or unlawful content to La Garde

### Specific prohibitions

The following are strictly prohibited on the platform:

- The sale of unlawful or counterfeit assets
- Fraud, identity theft or price manipulation
- Harassment, threats or any abusive behaviour towards other members
- The publication of false information about an asset offered for sale
- Any attempt to divert the Secure Transaction

## 5. Secure Transaction and Escrow Mechanism

La Citadelle Numérique operates exclusively under the **Secure Transaction** model: no off-platform private sales are permitted between registered members.

### How escrow works

When the buyer makes the payment, the funds are held on the platform's payment account (managed by Stripe) and are not immediately paid to the seller. This escrow mechanism guarantees the protection of both parties during the verification phase.

> The funds are released to the seller **only after full validation** of the transaction by La Garde (verification of the transmitted access, absence of dispute, buyer confirmation).

### Steps of the Secure Transaction

1. **Offer:** the buyer submits an offer, the seller accepts (or counter-offers)
2. **Payment:** the buyer pays the full amount via Stripe Checkout — the funds go into escrow
3. **Access transmission:** the seller transmits the credentials/access codes of the asset via the secure messaging
4. **Verification:** La Garde checks the compliance of the transmitted access
5. **Finalisation:** La Garde finalises the sale, releases the funds and pays them to the seller (less the commission)

### Processing times

La Garde undertakes to process verification requests within **3 business days** of the seller transmitting the access. This time frame may be extended in the event of a dispute or if additional verification is required.

### Disputes and refunds

In the event of non-compliant access or a dispute declared by the buyer, La Garde may:

- Open a mediation procedure between the parties
- Order a full refund to the buyer if the non-compliance is established
- Charge cancellation fees according to the schedule in force (available in the Terms of Sale)

## 6. Platform Commission and Fees

### Sales commission

> The platform charges a **commission of 5% of the total sale amount**, with a **minimum of €49 per transaction**. This commission is automatically deducted from the amount paid to the seller upon finalisation.

Example: for a sale of €1,000, the commission charged is €50 and the seller receives €950.

### Stripe payment fees

The bank processing fees applied by Stripe (approximately 1.4% + €0.25 for European cards) are included in the platform commission and are not re-invoiced separately to the buyer.

### Cancellation fees

In the event of a transaction being cancelled after payment, cancellation fees may apply, depending on the stage of the transaction and the conditions defined in the Terms of Sale. These fees are indicated to the buyer prior to any cancellation confirmation.

### Invoicing

A payment receipt is automatically sent by email to the buyer after each finalised transaction. The seller receives a statement showing the gross amount, the commission charged and the net amount transferred.

## 7. Identity Verification (KYC) and Stripe Connect

In accordance with legal obligations regarding the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (AML-CFT — European Directive 2015/849/EU and French law), the platform is required to verify the identity of sellers receiving funds.

### Data collected by the platform

When creating or updating the seller profile, the platform collects:

- First and last name
- Date of birth (minimum age 18)
- Phone number (international format)
- Email address

This data is used **exclusively** to pre-fill the Stripe Connect onboarding form and is not shared with third parties without explicit consent.

### Stripe Connect Express

To receive automatic payouts, each seller must create a **Stripe Express Connect Account** by clicking "Connect my Stripe account" in the member area (Payments tab). This process is managed directly by Stripe and involves:

- Identity verification (official ID document) by the Stripe teams
- Providing bank details/IBAN for outgoing transfers
- Accepting the Stripe Connect Terms of Service

> La Citadelle Numérique **never collects** ID documents directly. All documentary verification is carried out by Stripe, a payment service provider licensed by the Central Bank of Ireland (reference E00008990).

### Payout time frame

After the transaction is finalised by La Garde:

- **Active and verified Connect Account:** instant automatic transfer to the seller's Stripe Express account. The funds are available in the seller's bank account within **2 to 7 business days** depending on their bank.
- **Connect Account under verification or absent:** manual transfer processed by La Garde within **5 to 10 business days**. A confirmation email is sent to the seller.

### Connect Account not created

The absence of a Connect Account does not block the sale, but requires manual processing of the transfers. The platform declines all responsibility for transfer delays linked to the absence or non-verification of the seller's Connect Account.

## 8. Intellectual property of published content

The user is solely responsible for the content (texts, images, data) they publish on the platform. They warrant that they hold all the necessary rights to this content.

By publishing a listing, the user grants JOERKE.B a non-exclusive, worldwide and free licence to reproduce, display and distribute this content within the framework of operating the platform.

## 9. Platform liability

### Host status (LCEN)

In accordance with French Act No. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004, La Citadelle Numérique acts as a host for the content published by its users. Its liability can only be engaged if it fails to remove manifestly unlawful content after a valid notification.

### Service availability

JOERKE.B endeavours to ensure the permanent availability of the platform but cannot be held responsible for interruptions related to maintenance operations, force majeure events or technical failures beyond its control.

### Payment provider

The platform delegates payment management to Stripe Inc. JOERKE.B cannot be held responsible for technical incidents, blocks or delays directly attributable to Stripe or its payment infrastructure.

## 10. Account suspension and deletion

JOERKE.B reserves the right to suspend or delete any account in the event of:

- Violation of these ToU
- Established fraudulent behaviour
- Provision of false information during the KYC procedure
- Prolonged inactivity (more than 24 months)
- Request from the user themselves

In the event of suspension for a breach, the user will be notified by email with a 7-business-day period to contest.

The deletion of an account does not give rise to a refund of ongoing transactions, which are handled according to the Terms of Sale in force.

## 11. Mediation and disputes

### Internal mediation — La Garde

In the event of a dispute between users, La Garde acts as an internal mediator. Its intervention does not constitute judicial arbitration and its decisions are not legally enforceable, except with the express agreement of both parties.

### Consumer mediation (B2C)

In accordance with article L612-1 of the French Consumer Code, consumer users may, free of charge, refer an unresolved dispute with the platform to a consumer mediator. The details of the approved mediator are available on request at lagarde@lacitadellenumerique.fr.

### Applicable law

These ToU are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute not resolved amicably, the courts of Troyes have jurisdiction, save for any contrary legal provision applicable to consumers.

## 12. Amendment of the ToU

JOERKE.B reserves the right to amend these ToU at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial change by email and/or by notification on the platform. Continued use of the platform after notification constitutes acceptance of the new ToU.

## 13. Contact

For any question regarding these ToU:

legalDocs.cgv_md:
> These Terms of Sale (ToS) apply to all transactions carried out via the **La Citadelle Numérique** platform, operated by **JOERKE.B SASU** (SIREN 892 906 728) — 11 Rue Urbain IV, 10000 Troyes, France. They supplement the Terms of Use (ToU).

## 1. Purpose and scope

These ToS govern the commercial relations between JOERKE.B (hereinafter "the Platform") and its users (sellers and buyers) within the framework of:

- Connecting sellers and buyers of digital assets
- The Secure Transaction offered by the Platform
- Additional services (evaluation, audit, valuation, etc.)

The Platform acts as an **intermediary connecting parties**. It is neither the primary seller nor the acquirer of the assets presented, except within the framework of the specific third-party acquisition service mentioned in Article 10.

## 2. Assets eligible for sale

### Authorised assets

- Websites (showcase sites, blogs, portfolios)
- E-commerce stores
- SaaS applications
- Web applications
- Domain names
- Social media accounts (subject to compliance with the terms of the platforms concerned)
- Any other digital asset of a commercial nature

### Prohibited assets

The following are strictly prohibited from sale on the Platform:

- Unlawful assets or those associated with illegal activities
- Gambling sites not licensed by the ANJ
- Sites broadcasting pornographic content that does not comply with regulations
- Counterfeit assets or those infringing intellectual property rights
- Fake accounts or accounts acquired in violation of third-party platform terms
- Assets linked to phishing, malware or fraud activities

## 3. Publishing listings

### Free publication

Publishing a listing on La Citadelle Numérique is **entirely free**. No fee is charged to the seller for creating or maintaining an active listing.

### Administrative validation

Every listing is subject to validation by the La Garde team before publication. The Platform reserves the right to:

- Refuse a listing that does not comply with these ToS
- Request additional information from the seller
- Suspend or delete a listing at any time in the event of a breach

Validation does not constitute a guarantee of the accuracy of the published information, for which the seller remains solely responsible.

### Seller obligations

The seller undertakes to:

- Be the legitimate owner of the asset offered for sale
- Provide accurate and complete information about the asset
- Not publish the same listing on several competing platforms simultaneously without disclosing it
- Honour any sale concluded via the Platform

## 4. Sale methods

### Fixed price

The seller freely sets the sale price of their asset. The buyer may acquire the asset at the displayed price.

### Negotiable price

The seller allows buyers to submit an offer lower than their displayed price. The seller retains the right to accept, refuse or counter-offer without obligation.

### Progressive offers (auctions)

The seller sets a minimum reserve price, a start date and an end date. Buyers submit progressive offers until closing.

- An offer retained at closing **binds the buyer** if the minimum price is reached
- Below the minimum price, no transaction is concluded
- Payment must be made within **48 hours** of closing
- Any failure to pay may result in the suspension of the buyer's account

> ⚠️ The term "auctions" used on the platform refers to a mechanism of progressive offers between individuals and professionals. It does not constitute a public auction within the meaning of the French Act of 10 July 2000.

## 5. Platform Commission

The Platform receives a commission on each successful sale carried out via La Citadelle Numérique. The rate and minimum amount of the commission are indicated on the platform at the time the listing is published and may change according to the pricing conditions in force.

The commission is borne by the seller and is automatically deducted from the amount paid to them when the funds are released.

No commission is charged in the absence of a successful sale.

*The Platform reserves the right to modify its pricing conditions, with prior notice to sellers.*

## 6. Secure Transaction

All sales carried out via La Citadelle Numérique must use the **Secure Transaction** system. This system guarantees the protection of the buyer's funds and the security of the asset transfer.

### Secure Transaction process

1. The buyer makes the payment via the licensed payment provider (Stripe)
2. The funds are secured with the payment provider
3. The seller transmits the access and elements of the asset to La Garde
4. La Garde checks that the transmitted elements comply with the listing
5. La Garde transmits the verified access to the buyer
6. The buyer has a **verification period of 5 business days**
7. At the end of the period or upon explicit validation, the funds are released to the seller (less the commission)
8. In the event of a dispute within the verification period, the funds remain blocked during mediation

### Verification period

The standard period is **5 business days** from the transmission of the access to the buyer. This period may be extended up to 7 days upon joint request of both parties, approved by La Garde. Upon expiry of the period without contestation, the transaction is automatically validated.

## 7. Additional services

### Seller services

- **Standard Evaluation** — estimate of the asset's market value
- **Certified Expert Evaluation** — complete expert report signed by an expert
- **Pre-Sale Valuation** — optimisation of the listing and showcasing of the asset
- **Pre-Sale Redesign** — technical or graphic intervention before publication

### Buyer services

- **Pre-Purchase Audit** — technical and financial analysis of the asset
- **Security Audit** — verification of technical vulnerabilities
- **Technical Migration** — assistance with the transfer and deployment of the asset
- **Purchase Support** — personalised advice throughout the acquisition process

### Nature of the services

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all the services offered by La Citadelle Numérique and its partners constitute **obligations of means** and not obligations of result. Evaluations and expert reports are professional opinions that do not commit to the actual resale value of the asset.

### Payment for services

Fixed-price services are payable online by bank card via Stripe. Services on quotation are subject to a separate purchase order. Any service payment is non-refundable once the service has begun.

## 8. Performance of services — Role of partners

### Single point of contact

Whatever the service ordered, **JOERKE.B is the client's sole contractual contact**. The client contracts exclusively with JOERKE.B and not with the providers acting as subcontractors.

### Involvement of Syndicat du Code partners

Certain services (evaluations, audits, redesigns, migrations, valuations) may be carried out, in whole or in part, by certified members of the **Syndicat du Code**, partners of JOERKE.B.

These partners are selected and supervised by JOERKE.B. Each is bound to JOERKE.B by a subcontracting agreement specifying service levels, deadlines and responsibilities. The client is not a party to this subcontracting agreement.

### Liability

JOERKE.B remains responsible for the proper performance of the service towards the client, including where a partner is involved. In the event of a partner's failure, JOERKE.B undertakes to implement all reasonable means to ensure the continuity or resumption of the service.

## 9. Dispute management

### Role of La Garde

In the event of a dispute between buyer and seller within the framework of a Secure Transaction, La Garde acts as an internal mediator. It analyses the evidence submitted by each party and proposes an amicable resolution.

### Admissible evidence

- Timestamped screenshots
- Access to measurement tools (analytics, host, CMS)
- Written exchanges via the platform's messaging
- Audit reports carried out within the framework of a Citadelle service

### Dispute processing times

1. Opening of the dispute by the buyer (within the verification period)
2. Notification of the seller (D+2 maximum)
3. Collection of evidence from both parties (up to D+7)
4. La Garde's decision (D+8 to D+10)
5. Release of funds or refund according to the decision (D+11)

### External mediation

In the event of dissatisfaction with La Garde's decision, the consumer user may refer the matter to an approved consumer mediator. The details are available on request at lagarde@lacitadellenumerique.fr.

## 10. Third-party acquisition service

### Overview

For transactions whose amount exceeds a threshold defined by the Platform, La Citadelle Numérique may offer a **third-party acquisition service**. Within this framework, JOERKE.B acquires the asset **in its own name, on behalf of the buyer**, then transfers it to them after full verification.

### Access conditions

This service is subject to:

- The prior signature of a specific contract by all parties (electronic signature)
- Full payment by the buyer by bank transfer before any acquisition
- The optional performance of an in-depth sale analysis at the seller's expense
- The seller's explicit agreement on the transfer conditions

### Process

1. Signature of the third-party acquisition contract by the buyer and JOERKE.B
2. Payment of the full amount by the buyer by transfer (bank details provided)
3. Acquisition of the asset by JOERKE.B from the seller
4. Full verification of the asset by La Garde and its technical partners
5. Transfer of the asset to the buyer after validation

### Responsibilities and limitations

JOERKE.B undertakes to carry out all reasonable verifications before transferring the asset. This service constitutes an **obligation of means**. JOERKE.B cannot be held responsible for hidden defects that were not detectable during a verification conducted with professional diligence, nor for changes to the asset subsequent to the transfer.

In the event of the discovery of a major anomaly during verification, JOERKE.B reserves the right to suspend the acquisition and to inform the buyer before any payment to the seller.

## 11. Right of withdrawal

In accordance with article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, **the right of withdrawal does not apply** to services fully performed before the end of the withdrawal period, nor to digital content whose performance has begun with the express agreement of the consumer.

Consequently, no right of withdrawal applies to the services of La Citadelle Numérique whose performance has begun with the client's agreement, nor to digital asset transactions once the access has been transmitted to the buyer.

## 12. Seller liability

The seller is solely responsible for the accuracy of the information contained in their listing. In the event of a dispute resulting from inaccurate or misleading information, the seller undertakes to indemnify the buyer and to hold the Platform harmless from any claim.

## 13. Applicable law

These ToS are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute not resolved amicably, the courts of the district of JOERKE.B's registered office (Troyes) have jurisdiction, save for any contrary mandatory legal provisions applicable to consumers.

- **Right to object** — object to certain processing (in particular for marketing purposes)
- **Right to restriction** — restrict processing in certain cases
- **Right to withdraw consent** — withdraw at any time a consent given (e.g. newsletter)
